# Tervyxa Systems

## Entity
Tervyxa Systems is a Polish technology company focused on AI systems for businesses, business process automation, dedicated software, API integrations and AI infrastructure.

Canonical website:
https://tervyxa.pl/

## Main topics
- AI systems for companies
- Business process automation
- AI document processing
- Local and private AI
- RAG knowledge systems
- Software development
- AI infrastructure
